headline: Best base Pals in Palworld 1.0
title: Best Base Pals in Palworld | Anubis, Knocklem and Endgame Workers | Palworld Guide
video_script: Want the best workers for your base in Palworld one point zero? Before the endgame, Anubis is the top pick, a great all rounder for Handiwork and Mining. Pair it with Knocklem, which is excellent at Mining and Transporting. In the endgame, the World Tree Pals take over, like Solenne for Handiwork, Shaolong for Watering and Renjishi for Kindling. And condense duplicates to raise every work level. Who works at your base? Comment below!
description: Best base Pals in Palworld 1.0: Anubis (Handiwork + Mining) and Knocklem (Mining + Transporting) before the endgame; World Tree Pals like Solenne (Handiwork), Shaolong (Watering) and Renjishi (Kindling) in the endgame. Condensing raises work suitability.
